investigator: CIA Office of Inspector General 9/11 Accountability Review Team
employer_controller: Central Intelligence Agency, Office of Inspector General
verification_method: direct visual inspection of preserved official Executive Summary page images; no OCR used
report_or_finding: CIA OIG 9/11 Accountability Review — no single point/silver bullet plus systemic failures
exact_wording: The Team found neither a “single point of failure” nor a “silver bullet” that would have enabled the Intelligence Community (IC) to predict or prevent the 9/11 attacks. The Team did find, however, failures to implement and manage important processes, to follow through with operations, and to properly share and analyze critical data.
scope: Balanced OIG formulation concerning causal/accountability analysis before 9/11: no single failure or simple preventive solution was identified, while multiple process, operational follow-through, information-sharing, and analytical failures were identified.
source_pages: Executive Summary physical p. 3 / Roman p. vii
records_reviewed: CIA accountability-review record set summarized by the OIG
workpapers_status: The public Executive Summary presents the high-level finding; detailed supporting record chains remain in the full report/workpapers.
notes: Keep both halves together. Quoting only the no-single-point sentence or only the failures sentence would materially distort the OIG formulation.
